title: 2435. Paths in Matrix Whose Sum Is Divisible by K

examples.explanation: There are two paths where the sum of the elements on the path is divisible by k. The first path highlighted in red has a sum of 5 + 2 + 4 + 5 + 2 = 18 which is divisible by 3. The second path highlighted in blue has a sum of 5 + 3 + 0 + 5 + 2 = 15 which is divisible by 3.
The path highlighted in red has a sum of 0 + 0 = 0 which is divisible by 5.
Every integer is divisible by 1 so the sum of the elements on every possible path is divisible by k.
